name: Actinomycetoma (modified Welsh regimen)
advice: Confirm actinomycetoma by grain microscopy/culture and X-ray/MRI for bone. Before each amikacin cycle: creatinine, audiometry and CBC; repeat creatinine weekly. Co-trimoxazole needs CBC monthly, G6PD testing beforehand, and plenty of fluids. Treatment lasts many months — continue until no discharge and imaging is clear.

rx.instr: With co-trimoxazole after the intensive phase (two-step regimen)
